reviews.text: Fast, communicative, reasonably priced and did great job. Gave quote and was able to grind stump same day. Left no trace of stump and surrounding area was cleaned very well. Even helped to facilitate disposal of brush. Would recommend.
reviews.author: Christopher I.

reviews.text: Chris went above and beyond for us. He took out every stump and made everything look better than we were thinking it was going to end up. Thank you so much for all your help and hard work.
reviews.author: John D.

reviews.text: If you’re looking for a reliable local stump grinder in Palmyra, I highly recommend Chris at Stump Fleet. He was responsive, punctual, and very reasonably priced. Safety was clearly a priority—he took extra care to protect my home while working.
reviews.author: G P.
